clue.text: Gone! Fired over source of oil derivative

parts.note: something gone, like milk that has turned, is off

indicators.note: the shot is placed over, covering, the single letter from oil

parts.note: fired, as a gun, is shot

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone announces a departure as a shot rings out over an oil well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' puts O, the first letter of oil, inside SHOT to give SHOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshoot is something branching from an original, so a derivative of it.

clue.text: Respect honour given to royalty at last

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of royalty

explanation.surface: Respecting a royal award given to a monarch's subject.
explanation.walkthrough: The OBE is a British honour awarded by the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To obey someone is to show respect for their authority by following them.

clue.text: Part of school etiquette

definitions.meaning: a school class or year group
correct behaviour, as in good or bad manners

explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a class is called a form; 'bad form' means poor manners.
explanation.definitionFit: A form is a British school class, and 'good form' means proper etiquette.

clue.text: Temporary addition to capital growth

parts.note: reads like a short-term boost to financial capital, but capital is the head and growth is hair

explanation.surface: A temporary boost to a growing investment.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital is the head (Latin caput) and growth means hair growing on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A wig or toupee is worn on the head to add removable hair.

clue.text: Old player with the heart, perhaps, to work hard, eager to shed years

parts.note: the heart is an example of an organ of the body
to grind is to toil hard

indicators.note: to shed is to cast off, so the letters for years drop out

parts.note: an age is a long time, many years

explanation.surface: An old musician with heart works hard, keen to lose the years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' takes AGE out of EAGER, leaving ER. An organ grinder played a barrel organ in the street.
explanation.definitionFit: An organ grinder was a street musician playing a barrel organ, a player of an old kind.

clue.text: Grounds for divorce at last, say

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word divorce

parts.note: to say is to state

explanation.surface: A spouse finally declares the reasons for ending the marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a landed property, the grounds around a big house.

clue.text: Support case of Scotland protecting beat

indicators.note: protecting means the outer letters close around the word for beat
the case of a word is its first and last letters

parts.note: to tan someone is to beat them

explanation.surface: A Scottish defence beats back an attack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protecting' puts TAN between S and D, the first and last letters of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand is something that holds an object up, a support.

clue.text: They enhance the sound of fair and simple letters

indicators.note: letters here means the letters of the words are taken and reassembled

explanation.surface: Loudspeakers make fair and plain writing sound better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' tells you to use the letters of FAIR and SIMPLE in a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: Amplifiers boost an audio signal, making sound louder.

clue.text: Just passed under, flat

indicators.note: under says, in a down clue, the word for passed sits below the word for flat

parts.note: even means flat or level
passed, as in handed over, is handed

explanation.surface: Something just passed beneath, lying flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Even-handed means fair and impartial, which is what just means.

clue.text: The wages of sin, seething with anger

indicators.note: seething suggests something churning and boiling, so the letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: A preacher quotes that the wages of sin is death, in a furious temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seething' churns the letters of SIN and ANGER together.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnings are money paid for work, which is the plain sense of wages.

clue.text: Publication with kind of chart for obsessive collector

parts.note: a mag is a magazine, a publication
a pie chart shows proportions as slices of a circle

explanation.surface: A magazine runs a graph aimed at people who hoard things.
explanation.definitionFit: A magpie is a bird that hoards shiny things, so figuratively a compulsive collector.

clue.text: Log of charges for entry

parts.note: reads like a record of entry fees, but it is a heavy log used to charge at a door to force a way in

explanation.surface: A ledger listing admission fees.
explanation.walkthrough: Log means a tree trunk and charges means rushes at, not fees.
explanation.definitionFit: A battering ram is a heavy beam used to smash a door or gate.

clue.text: What to eat at golf championship course?

parts.note: the Open is the British Open golf championship
Sandwich, a town in Kent, England, has the Royal St George's golf course, an Open venue

explanation.surface: A spectator asks what food is available at the Open venue.
explanation.walkthrough: SANDWICH is a town in Kent whose Royal St George's links has hosted the Open; the question mark flags the pun on a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: An open sandwich is a single slice of bread with topping, something to eat.

clue.text: Brook policy to run things more efficiently

parts.note: a brook is a small stream
a line is an official policy, as in the party line

explanation.surface: A management plan named after a creek, for running things better.
explanation.definitionFit: To streamline an organisation is to make it work more simply and efficiently.

clue.text: In the course of events, it may lead to total recall

definitions.text: In the course of events, it may lead to total recall

parts.words: In the course of events, it may lead to total recall
parts.note: reads like perfect memory, but events are races on a course and the runners are all called back

explanation.surface: Over time, something may trigger complete memory.
explanation.walkthrough: Events are athletics races; after a jump at the start the runners are recalled.
explanation.definitionFit: A false start is when a racer moves before the gun, so all runners are called back.

clue.text: Manage, to locate returning vehicle in case of trouble

indicators.note: in places the turned vehicle inside the outer letters of trouble
the case of a word is its first and last letters, its outer shell
returning means the word for the vehicle is read backwards

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A driver manages to find a car coming back after a breakdown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' reverses the vehicle, and 'in' sets it inside the first and last letters of trouble; the comma in the definition is surface punctuation only.
explanation.definitionFit: To trace someone is to succeed in finding them after a search.

clue.text: Memory that's concerned with expression of stress

parts.note: re means concerning, as in a letter heading

indicators.note: expression here means speaking a word, so what follows is a sound-alike

parts.note: stress is tension

explanation.surface: A psychologist links recall with how strain is shown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expression of' says TENSION is heard, giving the spelling TENTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Retention is the ability to keep things in mind, a synonym for memory.

clue.text: Romantic pieces from noisy rap acts?

indicators.note: noisy says the following words are heard rather than read

parts.note: a rap is a knock and acts are turns, as on a stage

explanation.surface: Love songs coming from rowdy hip-hop performers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noisy' says KNOCK TURNS is heard, giving NOCTURNES. Romantic refers to the 19th-century musical era of Chopin.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocturnes are dreamy piano pieces, famously by Chopin in the Romantic era.

clue.text: Laurence taken in by listener — one from Boston, say

indicators.note: taken in by puts the novelist inside the word for a listener

parts.note: the ear is the organ that listens
Laurence Sterne wrote Tristram Shandy

explanation.surface: Someone named Laurence is fooled by a person overhearing him.
explanation.walkthrough: Laurence Sterne (1713-68) is the novelist; Boston lies on the US east coast, hence 'say' marking an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Boston is in the eastern United States, so a Bostonian is an example of a person from the East.

clue.text: Cut produced by desire, with a shifting to the left

indicators.note: shifting to the left moves the letter one place earlier in the word

parts.note: to desire is to crave

explanation.surface: A carving made out of longing, with something moved sideways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifting to the left' moves the A of CRAVE one place back.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut, as with meat or wood.

clue.text: Offence for which no dummies are released

indicators.note: released lets the letters go free to settle in a new order

explanation.surface: A minor crime for which no models or babies' pacifiers are set free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'released' frees the letters of NO DUMMIES ARE to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A misdemeanour is a minor wrongdoing, a petty offence.

clue.text: Regular heartbeat, finishing race?

parts.note: even means regular, steady

indicators.note: finishing points to the final letter of heartbeat

explanation.surface: A runner's steady pulse at the end of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A race is an example of an event in a sports meeting, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Sink under pressure —- a long story

parts.note: to sag is to sink or droop under weight

explanation.surface: A tale of something collapsing under strain.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is a lengthy tale, originally an Old Norse epic of heroes and families.

clue.text: Eastern potentate adopting very many girls

indicators.note: adopting means the potentate takes in the letter for very

parts.note: a bey was a Turkish governor

explanation.surface: An Oriental ruler takes in a great number of young women.
explanation.walkthrough: A bey was a governor in the Ottoman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: A bevy is a group, used especially of girls or women.

clue.text: Wise man is outside seeing visions

indicators.note: outside means the word is wraps around the wise man

parts.note: a mage is a magus, a wise man

explanation.surface: A sage stands outdoors having visions.
explanation.definitionFit: Images are pictures in the mind, the same as visions.

clue.text: Can't put in order — right about that cut

indicators.note: about means going around, so the word for right surrounds the rest

parts.note: true means right, correct

indicators.note: put in order says the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Someone unable to sort things out admits they were right to make a cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in order' rearranges the letters of can't, and 'about' wraps the word for right around them; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: To truncate is to shorten by cutting off a part.

clue.text: The existence of a songbird in Eastern state

indicators.note: in puts the songbird inside the letters for east and the state

parts.note: NY is New York state
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A bird's life in an eastern American state.
explanation.walkthrough: The songbird sits between the two letters of the state's abbreviation, after the E.
explanation.definitionFit: An entity is a thing that exists, and in philosophy the word also means being or existence.

clue.text: Agent possibly raises my problem

indicators.note: a problem is something tangled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a spy keeps creating difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'problem' jumbles the letters of RAISES MY.
explanation.definitionFit: An emissary is a person sent on a mission, an envoy or agent.
